Hi,
We never changed anything in the config and the backend should not limit the power. How can this happen? I see that we have also other charging sessions with high power.
Kind regards,
Catalin
Internal

additional_info.subject: ID0463976-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP / S5 170003620] Low power delivery CRM:03097000243
additional_info.body:
Hello Catalin,
Thanks for your feedback.
Unfortunately, these commands
cannot and will not
be performed by the charger. This is a regular command from the backend to the charger.
We only accept the command and forward the request to the charging controller.
You need to reach out to the responsible for this logic and understand why, at this period in time, they sent a 0kW limit to the charger.
I will wait for your feedback to understand if you could find the root cause.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
